newsitem.title: MEXICO: Lamosa, Siam Cement subsidiary in joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Lamosa, Siam Cement subsidiary in joint venture.

text.p: Monterrey-based construction firm Grupo Lamosa has agreed to a joint venture with TiliCera, a subsidiary of the Thai giant Siam Cement, Monterrey newspapers reported on Tuesday, citing Grupo Lamosa President Antonio Elosua Muguerza.

The association involves the sale of Lamosa Revestimientos, a subsidiary of tile-maker Ladrillera Monterrey (Lamosa) and the acquiring of 10 percent of TiliCera by the Monterrey group, El Diario de Monterrey said.
In addition, the deal includes an option to buy up to 49 percent of both companies within two years.
The partnership foresees issuing shareholding capital of which Lamosa Revestimientos will retain 75 percent with the rest going to TiliCera, the newspaper El Norte said.
"Although I cannot reveal the exact amount of the sale, I can say that it is several tens of millions of dollars," said Lamosa director Federico Toussaint Elosua, according to El Norte.
Toussaint said Siam Cement has annual sales of more than $6 billion, of which eight percent, or $480 million, involves ceramic wall covering, the division central to the deal.
Siam Cement has diverse interests, including construction, steel, petrochemical products, auto parts and tires.
"We are going to have to grow more than 30 percent in a period of a year and a half," Toussaint Elosua said in El Norte. "We will have to invest about $15 million, at least."
